responsibility: Declares the Blackfin-specific command-line options and their associated target variables for GCC’s generated option-processing framework. This file defines switches for CPU selection, silicon revision and anomaly workarounds, PIC/FDPIC and shared-library modes, call and frame-pointer behavior, memory placement, multicore/core selection, and related backend feature flags, providing the authoritative mapping from user-visible -m options to backend state such as bfin_cpu_type, bfin_si_revision, and workaround bitmasks.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated-options definition file for the Blackfin port: it maps Blackfin-specific -m switches and option variables such as CPU selection, silicon revision, workarounds, FDPIC, and multicore settings into GCC's option-processing framework. Unlike bfin.cc it does not implement backend semantics, unlike bfin.h it does not provide target macros/assembler interfaces, and unlike bfin.md it does not describe RTL instruction patterns or scheduling.
